edgeAATolerance.reason: Measured on CI 39722299676 (3 identical runs, 18 pairs, scale 1, Mac window-server capture vs Windows, full keyboard access ON): ring colour (127,179,250) vs (128,179,250); ring positions and 4 px thickness agree. Residual: the plain and borderless rings hug the text and the Mac text is wider than Segoe (a few px at the ring ends), the bordered corner shape, and a 1-level colour offset of the window-server capture (hazeTolerance 2). Worst row: maxInBand 127, over-32 pixels 122 of 8079 (1.5%), mean 1.97. Tolerance = measured plus margin.
